metadata.family_label: Threads, Knobs, Standoffs and Shaft Features
metadata.scope: Knurled knobs, hex standoffs, D-flat shafts, keyways, DIN 471 circlip grooves.

material_suggestions.use_case: machined knobs, standoffs, and shaft collars
material_suggestions.notes: Knurl with carbide knurling wheel at 0.8 mm pitch.

material_suggestions.use_case: printed or machined knobs and spacers
material_suggestions.notes: Good surface feel; machines cleanly for knurl pattern.
Use grip_ridge approximation with $fn=24 or fewer for texture.

standards_used.name: DIN 6885A keyway
standards_used.applies_to: keyway width and depth in hub or shaft
standards_used.note: ø20 mm shaft: key 6×6 mm, shaft depth 3 mm, hub depth 3.3 mm.

standards_used.name: DIN 471 circlip groove
standards_used.note: ø20 shaft: groove ø19.0 mm, width 1.2 mm, depth 0.5 mm.

standards_used.name: ISO metric minor diameters
standards_used.note: M3 self-tap bore: 2.5 mm print; M4: 3.3 mm; M5: 4.1 mm.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: Knurled adjustment knob

fit_guidance_mm.bore: insert bore for M3 heat set = 4.2 mm; self-tap = 2.8 mm

design_rules: grip ridges are small cylinders or cubes added around knob circumference in for-loop
bore is subtractive cylinder through full height
grip radius ≈ knob_d/2 so ridges just protrude from surface
failure_modes: no grips — smooth cylinder, not a knob
bore missing — cannot mount on shaft
grip ridges inside bore — geometry error

constraint_checks.message: Knob should have repeated grip features for ergonomic gripping.
